UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private sanctuary account profile for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Full display name from Google profile or user input.

preferredName.description: Optional preferred greeting name inside My World.

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from auth provider.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profiles, accessible strictly by the owning authenticated user.
